title: I’m writing to let you know…

options.text: I’m writing to let you know
I’m writing to letting you know

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: A purpose infinitive uses to + base verb. Correct: I’m writing to let you know

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: A purpose infinitive uses to + base verb. Correct: I’m writing to let you know

options.text: Just to let you know, the date has changed
Just to let you knowing, the date has changed

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: Use let + person + base verb: let you know. Correct: Just to let you know, the date has changed

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: Use let + person + base verb: let you know. Correct: Just to let you know, the date has changed

options.text: Please confirm whether can you attend
Please confirm whether you can attend

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: A request containing whether keeps subject + modal order. Correct: Please confirm whether you can attend

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: A request containing whether keeps subject + modal order. Correct: Please confirm whether you can attend

options.text: I’m writing to let you to know about the change
I’m writing to let you know about the change

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: The first to marks purpose; after let you, use know without another to. Correct: I’m writing to let you know about the change

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: The first to marks purpose; after let you, use know without another to. Correct: I’m writing to let you know about the change

options.text: Quick update: the dates we agreed on has changed
Quick update: the dates we agreed on have changed

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: Have agrees with the plural dates, even with a relative clause in between. Correct: Quick update: the dates we agreed on have changed

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: Have agrees with the plural dates, even with a relative clause in between. Correct: Quick update: the dates we agreed on have changed

questions.prompt: Choose the form for a reply deadline

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: By introduces the latest time for one reply; until describes continuation. Correct: Please confirm by Friday

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: By introduces the latest time for one reply; until describes continuation. Correct: Please confirm by Friday

questions.context: You need one confirmation no later than Friday

phrases.displayText: Who is this update for, and what do they need to do?
phrases.translation: Para quem é esta atualização e o que essa pessoa precisa fazer?

phrases.displayText: One version is for a client, another for a friend. Both need to confirm attendance
phrases.translation: Uma versão é para um cliente, outra para uma amiga. Ambos precisam confirmar presença

phrases.displayText: What are the facts that must stay the same?
The event moves from Friday the fourth to Monday the seventh of December. Time and room stay the same
phrases.translation: O evento passa de sexta, quatro, para segunda, sete de dezembro. Horário e sala continuam iguais

phrases.displayText: And the response deadline? “Tomorrow” could become unclear if the message is read late
phrases.translation: E o prazo de resposta? “Amanhã” pode ficar confuso se a mensagem for lida depois

phrases.displayText: Then I’d write Friday the fourth at five, rather than rely on the sending date
phrases.translation: Então escreveria sexta, quatro, às cinco, em vez de depender da data do envio

phrases.displayText: Would a more formal opening make the client version more proficient?
phrases.translation: Uma abertura mais formal tornaria a versão para o cliente mais proficiente?

phrases.displayText: Not automatically. “I’m writing to let you know” is useful if the purpose is still easy to find
phrases.translation: Não automaticamente. “Escrevo para informar” é útil se o propósito continuar fácil de encontrar

phrases.displayText: “Quick update: it’s Monday now. Same time and room. Can you confirm by Friday at five?”
phrases.translation: “Atualização rápida: agora é segunda. Mesmo horário e sala. Pode confirmar até sexta às cinco?”

phrases.displayText: That’s shorter, but it still keeps the action and deadline
phrases.translation: É mais curto, mas mantém a ação e o prazo

phrases.displayText: Exactly. Changing the register shouldn’t change the commitment we ask for
phrases.translation: Exatamente. Mudar o registro não deve mudar o compromisso que pedimos
